name: Shidou Yuuma
source:
Hobbies: Fishing
Likes: Older women, pervy jokes, his family, shaved ice
Dislikes: Every other guy except for Toshiki, people who leave their works to be finished by others, people who hate their talents

[url=/c98086]Toshiki's[/url] classmate. Although is quite narcissistic and tends to hit on women, he is also able to give serious and well-thought advice when needed. As a writer, Yuuma is the kind of person who researches what gets used in the trending bestsellers or what's popular in general, and incorporates them in his stories.
He is also [url=/c98130]Shion's[/url] twin brother. Just like his sister, he claims to be the older one.

[Based on the [url=http://ainolinks.com/]official website[/url]]
